title: Is someone reading this right now?
passage: Every time you join café Wi-Fi, hackers can see your passwords, your bank balance, even your private photos. It happens to millions of people every day, and most never find out until it's too late. Don't be next. Protect every device in your home with Shroudline for $11.99 a month.
cue: hackers can see your passwords, your bank balance, even your private photos
explanation: The ad paints a vivid, sweeping threat with no evidence of how often it really happens. Most sites already encrypt logins, so the danger is inflated to sell the subscription.

whyNot.fal_slippery_slope: There's no chain of events here; the ad simply inflates one threat to scare you into buying.

passage: PSA: please stop microwaving your leftovers. The radiation scrambles your food at the molecular level, and nobody is talking about what that's doing to your body over time. We threw ours out last year and I sleep so much better knowing it's gone. My kitchen reset guide is linked in bio.
cue: nobody is talking about what that's doing to your body over time
explanation: Mira hints at a vague, unsupported danger to get followers to ditch their microwaves. She offers no evidence of harm, just an ominous suggestion of what might be happening.

whyNot.fal_appeal_to_emotion: The post's pull comes specifically from dread of hidden harm, not from pride, guilt or another feeling.

title: Action needed: file migration by Friday
passage: Hi all, on December 1 we're moving shared files to Coffer Drive. The current server is out of warranty, and Coffer adds the version history many of you requested. Please migrate your folders this week. Anyone who leaves files on the old server is putting the whole company at risk. One ransomware attack and we could all be out of a job by Christmas.
cue: One ransomware attack and we could all be out of a job by Christmas.
explanation: The email gives solid reasons to migrate, then tacks on a dramatic worst case: everyone jobless by Christmas. That inflated threat isn't supported and replaces an honest account of the risk.

whyNot.fal_slippery_slope: There's no step-by-step chain; the email jumps straight to a single exaggerated disaster to scare people into acting.

source: Resident Bernard Lyle · Wrenford parks meeting
passage: I support giving teenagers more to do in this town, and the skate park design looks well thought out. But a park like that draws strangers from all over the county, and I won't stand here and pretend our children will be safe once it opens. Ask yourselves if you'd let your eight-year-old walk past it alone.
cue: I won't stand here and pretend our children will be safe once it opens
explanation: Bernard offers no evidence that skate parks put children in danger; he invites the room to imagine the worst. Fear of strangers stands in for any data about actual risk.

whyNot.fal_slippery_slope: Bernard doesn't lay out a chain of escalating steps; he relies on a vague, unsupported threat to children's safety.

title: Sleep coach urges parents to pull bedtime tablets
passage: In a survey of 40 families, children who read on tablets before bed fell asleep about 12 minutes later on average. Pediatric sleep coach Talia Prescott says parents shouldn't wait for more research: 'Every night you hesitate, you're gambling with your child's developing brain.' She is launching a screen-free bedtime course next month.
cue: Every night you hesitate, you're gambling with your child's developing brain.
explanation: The survey found a modest 12-minute delay, but Talia frames it as a threat to children's brains. The alarm far outruns the evidence, and fear does the persuading.

whyNot.fal_slippery_slope: She doesn't trace a chain of steps from tablets to disaster; she inflates a small finding into a frightening threat.

passage:
Lucia: Finally opening a high-yield savings account for the house fund. 4.1% at Thimble Bay Bank.
Uncle Desmond: Banks fail more often than they let on. One bad week and your account is frozen and you're standing outside a locked door while your down payment disappears. I keep mine in a safe at home.
Lucia: Isn't the account insured, though?
cue: you're standing outside a locked door while your down payment disappears
explanation: Desmond paints a vivid scene of a vanishing down payment without weighing how rare bank failures are or how deposit insurance works. The image does the persuading, not the actual risk.

whyNot.fal_slippery_slope: Desmond isn't predicting a chain set off by Lucia's choice; he uses one exaggerated disaster scene to frighten her.

title: CO detectors: replacing expired units this week
passage: Hi residents, our annual inspection found expired carbon monoxide detectors in 6 of our 40 units. Every unit here has a gas furnace, and carbon monoxide has no smell or color, so a working detector is the only practical warning if a furnace malfunctions. That's why replacing the expired ones matters, and we'll install new units free this Thursday.
cue: carbon monoxide has no smell or color, so a working detector is the only practical warning
explanation: Rhea warns of a real hazard and ties it to specific facts: gas furnaces in every unit, an odorless gas and expired detectors. The action directly reduces that risk.

whyNot.fal_appeal_to_fear: The danger is real, specific to this building and actually addressed by the action, not exaggerated to frighten.

title: Boil-water advisory issued after north-side main break
passage: Halverton Water says pressure in the north district fell below 20 psi for six hours after Tuesday's main break. Low pressure can let groundwater seep into pipes, so the utility says tap water there may not be safe to drink until two rounds of bacteria tests come back clean, likely by Friday. Boiling water for one minute kills the bacteria of concern.
cue: Low pressure can let groundwater seep into pipes
explanation: The utility names a specific event, explains how it could contaminate the water and says when the warning should end. The concern is sized to real evidence.

whyNot.fal_appeal_to_fear: The warning rests on a measured pressure drop and a known contamination route, with a clear end point, not on exaggerated dread.
